gloss: lodging fee; accommodation cost; room charge

definitions.gloss: lodging fee; accommodation cost; room charge
definitions.explanation: The cost of staying at a hotel, inn, or other accommodation. A colloquial and practical term used when discussing travel expenses.

examples.japanese: {宿代|やどだい}はいくらですか。
examples.english: How much is the lodging fee?

examples.japanese: {宿代|やどだい}を{節約|せつやく}するためにゲストハウスに{泊|と}まった。
examples.english: I stayed at a guesthouse to save on accommodation costs.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}の{予算|よさん}のうち、{宿代|やどだい}が{一番|いちばん}{大|おお}きな{出費|しゅっぴ}だった。
examples.english: Of the travel budget, lodging was the biggest expense.

notes:
A compound of {宿|やど} (inn; lodging) and {代|だい} (fee; charge). This is the everyday, conversational way to refer to accommodation costs. The word {宿|やど} by itself can mean any kind of lodging, from a traditional {旅館|りょかん} to a modern hotel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿代|やどだい}を{払|はら}う: to pay the lodging fee
- {宿代|やどだい}を{節約|せつやく}する: to save on lodging costs
- {宿代|やどだい}{込|こ}み: lodging included
- {一泊|いっぱく}の{宿代|やどだい}: cost per night

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宿泊料|しゅくはくりょう}: accommodation fee — more formal; used in hotel pricing and official documents
- {宿泊費|しゅくはくひ}: accommodation expenses — used in expense reports and budgeting
- {部屋代|へやだい}: room charge — focuses on the room itself rather than the lodging experience
